text:
Rose Labs careers — open positions (verified on site 2026-10-26)

The careers page at https://roselabs.ai/careers lists exactly 3 open positions (4 total openings). All are San Francisco, on-site, full-time, founding-level roles on a four-engineer team; all pay $600,000–$800,000 total cash ($300k–$400k base + up to 1× base bonus) plus up to 1% equity. The page does NOT link to an external jobs board (no Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/Workable) — every posting is a native /careers/... page on roselabs.ai. All three pages carry an active "Apply for this role" CTA (i.e., currently open).

1) Founding Research Engineer, Agent Harness — 2 openings (largest opening on the board)
- Summary: Founding-level research engineer who owns the end-to-end evaluation-and-improvement loop: mines real user runs for tasks where agents fail, turns them into hard reproducible benchmark tasks, then improves the agent harness and underlying decomposition/continual-learning models until they pass, verifying all measured gains. Requires meaningful production/research experience building LLM agent harnesses, strong ML fundamentals, disciplined measurement, strong Python engineering; RL/post-training, agentic benchmarks, program/prompt optimization, and learned-memory experience especially valued.
- URL: https://roselabs.ai/careers/founding-research-engineer-agent-harness [1][2]

2) Founding Infrastructure & Developer Tooling Engineer — 1 opening
- Summary: Founding-level infra engineer who owns the agent execution platform (durable workflows, sandboxed execution, Postgres, realtime fan-out) and the internal developer "software factory," scaling to mass concurrent agents and owning cost-per-completed-task and reliability as benchmark-scored metrics. Requires deep distributed-systems experience at scale, proven ability to make systems materially faster/cheaper, fluency in TypeScript or Python; durable execution (e.g., Temporal), production agentic/ML workloads especially relevant.
- URL: https://roselabs.ai/careers/founding-infrastructure-developer-tooling-engineer [1][3]

3) Founding Product Engineer — 1 opening
- Summary: Founding-level full-stack product engineer who invents the human-side experience for supervising thousands of hours-long agents (visibility, interruption/correction, trust decisions) and owns real-world integrations (email, messaging, payments, browser sessions, phone); stack is React/TypeScript, Node/Express, realtime systems, desktop app. Requires a strong full-stack engineer with genuine product taste who has shipped widely-adopted interfaces, owns outcomes over tickets, and handles ambiguity (stack: TypeScript/React/Node); LLM-product or realtime-interface experience especially valued.
- URL: https://roselabs.ai/careers/founding-product-engineer [1][4]

No other positions are listed anywhere on the careers page or its linked detail pages; there is no "no open roles" state and no external board to check.

Sources:
[1] https://roselabs.ai/careers (careers index; lists all 3 roles, "2 openings" for #1, no external jobs-board links)
[2] https://www.roselabs.ai/careers/founding-research-engineer-agent-harness
[3] https://www.roselabs.ai/careers/founding-infrastructure-developer-tooling-engineer
[4] https://www.roselabs.ai/careers/founding-product-engineer
